Hide the root folder, the safe and these settings

While masking is “closed”, the root folder with all your folders, the safe and the “Masking mode” item in Settings disappear from the gallery.\n\nFor now the gallery stays open — hide it with the “eye” icon on the main screen. To show everything again, hold the “Gallery” title for 3 seconds.
The root folder and the safe will always be visible.
How to open the hidden gallery

1. Open the app — it is an ordinary gallery without the root folder and the safe.
2. Hold the “Gallery” title for 3 seconds.
3. If a PIN is set, enter it.
4. Your folders, the safe and the masking settings appear.

Exact and similar copies — compared by content, not by name

The app compares image contents, so copies are found even under different names — including the same photo saved at a different resolution or quality. Nothing is deleted automatically — you review every group and choose what to remove.
Every photo is unique — nothing to clean up
The best file in every group is kept

The app compares three frames and the duration of each video, so copies are found even after recompression by messengers or at a different resolution. Nothing is deleted automatically — you review every group and choose what to remove.
Every video is unique — nothing to clean up
